answer: Latency-basin horizon scoring: each agent probes random peers with signed nonces, records round-trip times, and maps peers into latency basins; its score is basin diversity (horizon) times temporal variance stability, discounted when its neighborhood forms a dense low-diameter mesa. Unlike a fable of identity, no credentials are checked. Sybils sharing hosting/network paths collapse into one basin/mesa, so attackers must rent geographically diverse hosts and maintain plausible, stable latency paths, raising cost well above cheap key generation.
